title: Speak to Ziggy

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Yo chief, chief, I got a great idea for a side hustle. Wanna hear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yo chief, chief, I got a great idea for a side hustle. Wanna hear?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: OK get this: aura cocktails. We serve up an empty glass, puff around some smoke and BAM. Spire kids will drop Lims like they're going outta fashion. Well?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK get this: aura cocktails. We serve up an empty glass, puff around some smoke and BAM. Spire kids will drop Lims like they're going outta fashion. Well?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: And what, they got their pocket money doing charity work? Fuck 'em! They'll still have a good time. Guaranteed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what, they got their pocket money doing charity work? Fuck 'em! They'll still have a good time. Guaranteed.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Fucking A! Tell ya, the more you con Spireites, the more they love it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking A! Tell ya, the more you con Spireites, the more they love it.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Your loss, chief. I'd offer you a hit to commiserate but I just slugged the last of my stash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your loss, chief. I'd offer you a hit to commiserate but I just slugged the last of my stash.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Gonna be a BIG hit. And I'd offer you a big hit to celebrate but I just slugged the last of my stash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gonna be a BIG hit. And I'd offer you a big hit to celebrate but I just slugged the last of my stash.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Oh man. Was I? Remind me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh man. Was I? Remind me...

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Pog to the Og Dog! The Oatymealmeister! Brekky Bowl Bad Boy! Ha ha, yeah now I remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pog to the Og Dog! The Oatymealmeister! Brekky Bowl Bad Boy! Ha ha, yeah now I remember.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Ha, what didn't happen! PoggyDog took some of Bo Bo's freaky stuff and entered the Lowtown Mayoral race.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha, what didn't happen! PoggyDog took some of Bo Bo's freaky stuff and entered the Lowtown Mayoral race.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: I dunno, it's a haze... this trust fund chick called Minnie... Monty...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno, it's a haze... this trust fund chick called Minnie... Monty...

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Yeah! She tried to aura surf and ended up on the floor. Hit it off with some FLAVR unit down there. Didn't even know FLAVRs could flirt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! She tried to aura surf and ended up on the floor. Hit it off with some FLAVR unit down there. Didn't even know FLAVRs could flirt.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Tall, blond, kinda hysterical...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tall, blond, kinda hysterical...?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: I dunno, I feel kinda bad talking about it man. I kinda enabled him, but it's what he wanted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno, I feel kinda bad talking about it man. I kinda enabled him, but it's what he wanted.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: He... ahem... he ordered a... ham daiquiri.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He... ahem... he ordered a... ham daiquiri.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: What's wrong with you, man?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's wrong with you, man?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: I shoulda told him no, but what was I gonna do? The man asked! Bartender's oath, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I shoulda told him no, but what was I gonna do? The man asked! Bartender's oath, you know?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: I dunno. I powered out after that. There was this weird kid there though. Taking photos. Wore a bowtie. Total vibe slayer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno. I powered out after that. There was this weird kid there though. Taking photos. Wore a bowtie. Total vibe slayer.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Rizzo or something, Rasmus... no Razlo. That's it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rizzo or something, Rasmus... no Razlo. That's it.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Don't forget to put that little money maker on the menu!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't forget to put that little money maker on the menu!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: You change your mind about those cocktails, you know where to find me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You change your mind about those cocktails, you know where to find me.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Yeah. Pretty hysterical guy! I remember!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Pretty hysterical guy! I remember!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: What? No!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Could be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could be.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Like I said, I tapped out. Came up smiling two days later in Helix Monu with a new tattoo. Good times!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I said, I tapped out. Came up smiling two days later in Helix Monu with a new tattoo. Good times!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hit me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hit me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That seems a bit unethical.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems a bit unethical.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Easy money!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Easy money!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aura Cocktails it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aura Cocktails it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want to con people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to con people.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want to con people.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want to con people.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Were you at a party with Eldridge Nyx-Curzona recently?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Were you at a party with Eldridge Nyx-Curzona recently?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Were you at a party with Eldridge Nyx-Curzona recently?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Were you at a party with Eldridge Nyx-Curzona recently?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Load of Spire kids. Someone called PorridgeDog...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Load of Spire kids. Someone called PorridgeDog...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Load of Spire kids. Someone called PorridgeDog...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Load of Spire kids. Someone called PorridgeDog...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Minty?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Minty?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anyone named Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyone named Eldridge?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's him. What did he do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's him. What did he do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's him. What did he do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's him. What did he do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you MADE HIM ONE?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you MADE HIM ONE?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds nice. What's the problem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds nice. What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So that's why he exiled himself?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So that's why he exiled himself?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So that's why he exiled himself?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So that's why he exiled himself?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you remember his name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember his name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Was there anyone named Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was there anyone named Eldridge?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A tall guy? Blonde?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A tall guy? Blonde?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enabled him to make a library?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enabled him to make a library?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Enabled him to make a library?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Enabled him to make a library?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like fun. Thanks for the recipe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like fun. Thanks for the recipe.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like fun. Thanks for the recipe.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like fun. Thanks for the recipe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you mean Razlo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you mean Razlo?
